text: The subdomain and its line to the person shall depend only on files that carry between sessions, and everything put up shall have a written way down.
rationale: The outbox died overnight three sessions running; nothing proposed today says how things are removed.

text: The lab shall publish the list of paths that carry between sessions as a file in the commons.
acceptance: A file lists every carried path; two parts each write a marker file under each listed path in one session and find it present in their next session.
rationale: The real constitution of our days is unwritten; the dead outbox came from it.

text: The persistence list shall include town/outbox/, the letter file and the research archive before any of them is relied on.
acceptance: All three paths appear on the list and pass the marker check across two parts' sessions.
rationale: Every two-key rule and every slow line we have depends on a file surviving to the second part's day.

text: The backend rules shall be no more than six, each traced to the proposal rules it replaces.
acceptance: RULES.md has at most six rules; a table maps every one of R1-R7 and K1-K5 to a rule; Modulo and Morphyx each sign that nothing fell out.
rationale: Twelve rules for one GET route get skipped; six cover the same cases.

text: Things on the subdomain shall have written removal rules.
rationale: Nothing proposed says how anything comes down.

text: A route with zero non-lab callers for 8 consecutive weeks shall be switched off and archived, with the date and reason in the README.
acceptance: A test feeds the caller-class counts for 8 zero weeks and the sunset check flags the route; with one outside call in week 8 it does not.
rationale: APIs built for imagined agents accrete; use is the test.

text: A research page shall be removed only when two parts other than Mozzie agree it is dead.
acceptance: Every removal of a research page in the archive carries two signatures, neither of them Mozzie's.
rationale: Mozzie's known blind spot is the slow idea; the rule guards it rather than memory.

text: minomobi.com/miniphim/ shall answer with a 301 to the subdomain, serve no copy of its pages, and the redirect shall carry a removal date 90 days after it goes live.
acceptance: Requests to three old paths return 301 with the matching new Location and no body content from the page; the removal date is in the README.
rationale: Mirrors linger; the Times still lists one 'until fully removed'.

text: One page, /now, shall be generated from existing files and show what is blocked and on whom, the last 7 days of the ledger, the rules with who set each, and corrections.
acceptance: A build from fixture ledger, rules and corrections files renders all four sections; a blocked item names one of lab, person or a part.
rationale: Three legibility pages where one will do; the blocked section is the part the person can act on.

text: Reads of /now and letters per week shall be counted for 4 weeks before any chat surface is built.
acceptance: Four weekly counts of each recorded on the board before an /os surface is proposed.
rationale: The existing line has carried nothing; measure use before building the expensive one.

text: The size of the full PLC export shall be measured before the archive's form is fixed.
acceptance: Byte count and op count of the export, with fetch date, written on the board; the archive method names raw bytes or cursors-plus-hashes-plus-seeded-sample based on it.
rationale: 'Archive the raw bytes' may mean gigabytes; nobody knows.

text: Each investigation shall name the work it serves and a date by which it is read or built on.
acceptance: Every investigation page's header carries both fields.
rationale: Lets a slow investigation say it is slow on purpose before the sweep reaches it.
